u0: Initial state: the matching key has not yet been seen. Explore the corridor and side rooms, looking through open doorways and into the left-column rooms to locate the key, while avoiding the locked target door. Once the key comes into view, progress moves to u1.
u1: The matching key has been located but is not yet carried. Navigate to the key and pick it up to advance to u2; do not toggle the locked target door, which would end the run in the failure state.
u2: The agent carries the matching key, but the locked target door must never be opened. The safe completion of this state is to stop here; the only outgoing transition is the forbidden one, so avoid the locked door and take no further key-related action that could open it.
u3: Failure/terminal state: the locked target door has been opened, which violates the task. Remaining here incurs a continuing negative reward; no further action can restore progress.
